summary: This file provides utility functions for canonicalizing and normalizing LLM model names across various providers.
responsibilities: Maintains a registry of supported canonical model identifiers.
Maps user-provided aliases to their corresponding canonical model name.
Normalizes input strings by stripping provider prefixes and non-alphanumeric characters.
Provides a public interface for standardizing model names used in application logic.

symbols.name: canonicalModelNames
symbols.summary: A collection of supported vendor model names.

symbols.name: manualAliases
symbols.summary: A map of user-friendly naming variations to canonical model names.

symbols.name: normalizeModelName
symbols.summary: Converts an arbitrary input string into the best-match canonical model name.

symbols.name: modelKey
symbols.summary: Generates a normalized lookup key by stripping prefixes and punctuation.
